lucky_bamboo.name: Dracaena sanderiana
lucky_bamboo.care: Bright indirect light; moist well-draining potting mix for soil-grown plants. Water-grown plants require a different setup. Avoid assuming a universal watering interval.

hedge_bamboo.name: Bambusa multiplex
hedge_bamboo.care: A true clumping bamboo. Confirm pot size, cultivar, placement, drainage and establishment before giving specific watering or feeding advice.

pandacaqui.name: Tabernaemontana pandacaqui
pandacaqui.care: Full sun or semi-shade, moderate water, fertile loamy soil. Indoor window exposure must be assessed separately from outdoor sunshine.

divaricata.name: Tabernaemontana divaricata
divaricata.care: Includes the dwarf ornamental called Pandakaki in the Philippines. Confirm cultivar and growing conditions before prescribing exact care or fertilizer dosage.

calathea_group.name: Calathea / Goeppertia group
calathea_group.care: Bright indirect light, warm humid conditions, evenly moist but draining growing medium. Do not recommend strong direct sun. Feeding depends on active growth and the fertilizer label; do not apply UK calendar seasons to a tropical location automatically.
